findings: No requirement contract, channel plan, issue snapshot or selector changed.
Base and reference verification don't use Graphify or the new setting.
The skip policy and selectors are untouched.

Graphify setup builds the configured source_root, src by default, with graphify extract and --code-only, so docs and images next to the code never need a model key, and setup fails when the folder is missing (CFG-017). The smoke and solve wrapper refuses extract and any path-shaped first argument, which Graphify would build an index from, except its read commands query, path and explain, and the trace audit counts extract and builds of the configured folder.
checks.residual_uncertainty: Checked outside Codex with Graphify 0.9.31: an Actual Budget packages tree built with --code-only (7841 nodes in about 15 s). On the current Symphony src the old command fails without a key because 19 text snapshots count as docs; without them, the old command, --code-only and the extract form give identical node and edge sets. graphify hook install still passes the wrapper, as before this change.

findings: source_root is a progress fingerprint input for indexing, smoke and solve, and only one spelling per folder passes the parser, so timing history doesn't mix folders. Existing history for those stages starts over once because the context now always carries the folder.
